package example

import (
    "testing"
    "os"
    "net"
    "net/rpc"
    "fmt"
    "strings"
    sieve "sieve.client"
)

type Observer struct { begins chan sieve.NotifyLearnBeforeReconcileRequest }
func (o *Observer) NotifyLearnBeforeReconcile(r *sieve.NotifyLearnBeforeReconcileRequest, response *sieve.Response) error {
    o.begins <- *r; response.Ok = true; return nil
}
func (o *Observer) NotifyLearnAfterReconcile(r *sieve.NotifyLearnAfterReconcileRequest, response *sieve.Response) error {
    response.Ok = true; return nil
}

func TestBehavior(t *testing.T) {
    observer := &Observer{make(chan sieve.NotifyLearnBeforeReconcileRequest, 2)}
    server := rpc.NewServer()
    if err := server.RegisterName("LearnListener", observer); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; defer listener.Close()
    go func(){ connection, e := listener.Accept(); if e == nil { server.ServeConn(connection) } }()
    os.Setenv("sieveTestPlan", fmt.Sprintf(`{"sieveServerAddr":%q,"annotatedReconcileStackFrame":["example.(*Reconciler).Reconcile"],"crdList":[],"rateLimiterEnabled":false}`, listener.Addr().String()))
    defer os.Unsetenv("sieveTestPlan")
	r := &Reconciler{}
	value, err := r.Reconcile(3)
	if value != 6 || err != nil || r.Calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("changed result: %d %v %+v", value, err, r)
	}
	value, err = r.Reconcile(-1)
	if value != -1 || err == nil || r.Calls != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("changed early return: %d %v %+v", value, err, r)
	}
    for i:=0; i<2; i++ {
        begin := <-observer.begins
        if begin.InvocationID == "" || !strings.Contains(begin.InstanceID, "*example.Reconciler@") {
            t.Fatalf("instrumented receiver identity missing: %+v", begin)
        }
    }
}
